items.title: Valve Knows Steam Has An AI Slop Problem And Has A 'Significant Number Of People' Working On It
items.excerpt: Valve says a significant number of people are working on Steam's AI slop and clone problem, though it again puts the onus on the developers being ripped off.
items.rationale: Valve's first official response to the Next Fest AI-clone wave sets the store policy every Steam developer has to plan their demos around.

items.title: Epic Games further doubles down on gen-AI tools for Fortnite, Unreal Engine 6 and more: "Our engineers are no longer writing the bulk of the code"
items.excerpt: Epic Games confirmed it is using AI-assisted vibe-coding for everything from Unreal Engine 6 to Fortnite, saying its engineers no longer write the bulk of the code.
items.rationale: The engine most studios build on is now officially written mostly by AI, which changes how UE6 users should think about engine stability and tooling.

items.title: Roblox confirms no adult content used in AI training after scraping Open3DLab data
items.excerpt: Roblox says an AI agent failed to operate 'as intended' when it mass-downloaded 3D files, including adult content, from Open3DLab, Smutlab and SFMLab for AI training data.
items.rationale: A rogue scraping agent pulled community 3D assets into Roblox's training data, a concrete data-provenance incident 3D artists need to know about.

items.title: "네가 한 일을 알고 있다"...넥슨, 이용자 행동 기억하는 'AI NPC' 개발
items.excerpt: 넥슨이 이용자의 게임 내 행동을 '라이브 메모리'로 실시간 기억해 NPC가 과거 행동에 맞춰 반응하도록 하는 AI 엔진과 자체 DB '패스트그래프'를 공개했다. (off-list: allowed Korean outlets had no fresh copy)
items.rationale: Nexon unveiled a concrete memory engine and graph DB for persistent AI NPCs, a new system that game and narrative designers can actually build on.

items.title: 라인게임즈, Games on AWS 2026서 AI 퍼블리싱 자동화 노하우 공개
items.excerpt: 라인게임즈가 Games on AWS 2026에서 사내 AI 시스템으로 게임 개발 문서 자동 갱신과 퍼블리싱 업무를 자동화한 노하우를 공개했다.
items.rationale: A publisher's own account of automating dev-doc updates and publishing ops with in-house AI, a workflow other teams can copy.

https://kotaku.com/valve-steam-ai-clone-.new_action: Valve's first official statement on the Next Fest AI-clone problem: it says a 'significant number of people' are working on it and tells developers to make games harder to copy and to report extortion to police. Earlier cards (IGN 10-20, Kotaku 10-17, gamedeveloper 10-24, gamemeca 10-26) covered fans and developers, not a Valve response.

https://www.eurogamer.net/epic-genai-for.new_action: Epic (VP Marcus Wassmer) officially confirmed that Unreal Engine 6 and Fortnite are now developed with AI-written code and that engineers no longer write most of it. This is a new disclosure, not the launcher vibe-coding story (Verge 10-15), the AI-first memo (gamesindustry.biz 10-13), the $50k jam (10-23) or the EULA change (gamedeveloper 10-28).

dedup.note: One pick per cluster. Epic UE6/Fortnite AI-coding cluster: kept Eurogamer and dropped PC Gamer, Rock Paper Shotgun and Game Developer (the same Wassmer statement). Valve AI-clone cluster: kept Kotaku and dropped Game Developer, PC Gamer, Eurogamer and GamesRadar (the same Valve statement). Dropped as already published: Krafton Raon-1 mini (= gamemeca 10-22); Shogun 2 VP comment (commentary on the pulled remaster, Kotaku 10-15/10-16); Sakurai 'low-quality goods' (commentary following his 10-17 column); thisisgame indie devs hiding demos (running AI-clone story, inven 10-21 and others); NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops and the RTX Spark neural-rendering dev blog (same platform, blogs.nvidia 10-16 in games and 10-14 in design, no new release). Deprioritized: EA gen-AI mandate and EA morale (based on employee complaints, a labor/business angle, no official action); Kotaku Haunted Paws knockoff (another case in the AI-clone running story); Equity voice-actor warning (union advisory about one casting call, off-list outlet); IGN RDR2 Nemesis mod (10-19, stale); Gameple inZOI AI mods (10-19, stale). Cross-section: published_urls.json is too large to scan in full without grep. Only the design block was checked, and it has blogs.nvidia RTX Spark, so NVIDIA was avoided. The orchestrator should exact-grep these five URLs and 'Open3DLab', 'Nexon AI NPC'/'넥슨 라이브 메모리' and '라인게임즈 Games on AWS' across all sections before roll. Outlets: Kotaku, Eurogamer, Game Developer, 아이뉴스24, 디스이즈게임, one card each.
